title: Design: removing Service Parts in Edit Customer looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Use a customer with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" set to sales rep C.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "customer-12-n2-three.png" (board 2.12), "customer-13-n2-remove-tip.png" (board 2.13) and "customer-14-n2-ps-only.png" (board 2.14) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in that browser window.
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the three fields with the picture of board 2.12.
  2. Hover over the remove x beside Service Parts and compare with the picture of board 2.13.
  3. Click it and compare with the picture of board 2.14.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The fields read, in order: Service Labor sales rep A, Service Parts sales rep B, Part Sales sales rep C, as in the picture.

Step 2:

  • The tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows.

Step 3:

  • "Sales Representative" reads sales rep A.
  • "Sales Representative - Part Sales" reads sales rep C.
  • The + is back, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”
  • S4-R11: “Removing Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative" again. It keeps the Service Labor person, who becomes the customer's one representative for labor and parts. A Part Sales field, if added, keeps its choice.”
  • S4-R14: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", in the Part Sales field keeps that choice until someone changes the field or removes it. Changing Service Parts never changes it, even when both hold the same person.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.12 Three different people; 2.13 Hover the remove x; 2.14 Part Sales without Service Parts (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-12-n2-three.png, customer-13-n2-remove-tip.png, customer-14-n2-ps-only.png.

  • Design — board 2.13 title: “2.13 Hover the remove x”
  • Design — board 2.13 note: “Tooltip: "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts".”
  • Design — board 2.14 title: “2.14 Part Sales without Service Parts”

A customer can have its own Part Sales rep without splitting service. The + is back, offering Service Parts. Removing the Part Sales row puts part sales back on the Service Parts person (or the one rep).”
